title: My First English Class · 写作迁移
instructions: 给同班朋友写2—8个简单句、至少12词。先介绍自己，再对朋友说一句话，最后用We are介绍你和朋友共同的身份或状态。We必须包含你自己；信息可真实或自编。先独立写，再订正。
prompt: Write 2–8 simple sentences to a friend in your English class. Introduce yourself with I am. Say one thing to your friend with You are. Use We are for yourself and that friend together. Use your own or invented names and class details. Write at least 12 words. Do not copy a lesson example.
